summary.zh: 设计检索增强问答的分块、向量库与评估
summary.en: Design RAG chunking, embeddings, vector store and retrieval metrics.

description.zh: 为文档问答确定分块策略、嵌入模型和向量库，并给出检索质量怎么衡量的方法。适合从零搭检索、更换向量库，或回答总抓不到正确上下文的时候。选型需结合你的文档规模与预算。
description.en: Settles chunking, embedding model and vector store for search over docs, and defines how to measure retrieval quality. Use it to build retrieval, swap a vector database or when answers miss context. Choices depend on your corpus and budget.
